purpose: Stress-test calculations under a positive-definite but near-rank-one random-effects covariance matrix.
Verify that positive target-slope variance is not confused with an exact zero target-slope boundary.
Encourage numerically stable conditioning formulas that do not require an explicit inverse of G.
recommended_full_determinacy_route: C_i = G - G Z_i^T (Z_i G Z_i^T + R_i)^(-1) Z_i G
notes: The target slope variance is exactly 1.0 and therefore positive.
The covariance block is intentionally very close to rank one.
This fixture is a numerical stress case, not a request to truncate or repair G.
